children: China steel pipe maker's half-year revenue fell 56% yr/yr
Profit attributable to owners dropped 74% yr/yr
EPS declined to RMB 0.04 from RMB 0.17 yr/yr
Company did not provide specific guidance or outlook for future periods
MIDDLE EAST DELIVERY DELAYS – Revenue fell 56.0% as escalating Middle East geopolitical tensions delayed steel-pipe deliveries
ABSENCE OF PRIOR-YEAR GAINS – Other income fell 83.3%, mainly as 2025 included a subsidiary-disposal gain and bond and note write-offs
